data.title: Speeding fine: €98.50, 1 point
data.summary: The Kreis Musterland fines office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) dated 15 September 2026 for speeding 23 km/h over the limit outside built-up areas on 25 August 2026. The total is €98.50 and 1 point in the driving register.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving 93 km/h where 70 km/h is allowed. You can object (Einspruch) in writing or by recording it at the fines office. The letter was formally delivered, and the app shows the objection deadline, so check it soon because it is short. If you don't object, the decision becomes final and enforceable. Then you must pay €98.50 within two weeks of it becoming final, quoting the file number. If you disagree with the accusation, consider getting legal advice before the deadline.

items.title: File objection to fine notice
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or by recording it at the Kreis Musterland fines office.
items.consequence: Without an objection the notice becomes final and enforceable.
items.quote: Sie können gegen diesen Bescheid binnen zwei Wochen nach Zustellung Einspruch einlegen – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Musterland – Bußgeldstelle.

items.title: Pay fine of €98.50
items.action: Pay the total to the account named, quoting the file number 7.3-OWi-2026-88213. Due two weeks after the notice becomes final.
items.consequence: Not stated in the letter; the notice becomes enforceable once final.
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
